title: 第二十三章 女保镖伍十一第二十四章 抵达燕京
content_zh:
星期一，伍十一来到了星辰投资。
“你就是伍十一？”
姜辰打量着眼前的伍十一。
这个伍十一给她的感觉是英姿飒爽，比剧中年轻了不少。
按照时间算，伍十一的出现已经就是在剧情开始前四年，现在的伍十一从普通保镖晋升为A级保镖。
也在同一时间，系统的提示音响起。
“系统，签到。”
【恭喜宿主，签到成功，获得技能格斗精通。】
“格斗精通？”
姜辰心中一愣。
他还以为这次遇到伍十一，签到的也是公司股份，没想到是格斗精通。
在同一时间，关于格斗精通的相关知识出现在了姜辰的脑海中。
“是的，姜总。”伍十一看到姜辰也是十分的意外，之前她接到的任务是保护星辰投资老板，不过，对姜辰的资料他并没有，还以为是一个中年人，没想到却是一个年轻人。
“这是我让法务部准备的合同。”姜辰拿起办公桌上的合同递给了伍十一。
“三年时间？”
看了合同后，伍十一说道：“姜总，这时间是不是长了？”
“长吗？”
姜辰摇摇头，说道：“如果不是你们神鹰安保公司不同意，我还想和你确签更长的合同呢。不过你放心，虽然合同签的是三年时间，但除了给神鹰安保公司的，我还会给你一部分补贴。”
在姜辰的身上有不少的秘密，如果伍十一成为他的保镖的话，或多或少会知道一点的。为了保证秘密不被泄露，将伍十一留在身边无疑就是最好的选择。
“我不需要补贴。”伍十一说道。

“关于补贴，你们神鹰安保公司已经同意了，所以你不需要担心。”姜辰知道伍十一心中所想，开口解释道：“另外，除了成为我的保镖，二十四小时保护我之外，平时你还要充当我的司机。这有问题吗？”
“没有。”伍十一摇摇头。
“行了，你出去找聂星辰，让她安排你的工位。”姜辰说道。
“好的。”伍十一转身离开了。
姜辰靠在椅子上，消化着关于格斗精通的知识。
“这格斗精通不错，至少有了它可以有自保之力了，不过……”
姜辰想到了自己的身体情况。
虽然已经拥有了格斗精通，但如果自己的身体素质跟不上，即使是格斗精通，也发挥不出应有的实力的。
“看来接下来要努力锻炼身体才是。”
下午下班后，姜辰带着伍十一来到了君悦府的豪宅。
“姜总，你一个人住？”伍十一问道。
“对。不过我已经招保姆了，如果没有意外的话，过段时间应该会有保姆入主。”姜辰点点头，说道：“伍十一，你跟我来。我给你这里的监控权限，然后录电子锁和电梯的指纹。”
content_en:
On Monday, Wu Shiyi came to Xingchen Investment.
"Are you Wu Shiyi?"
Jiang Chen looked at Wu Shiyi in front of him.
This Wu Shiyi gave her the feeling of being heroic and much younger than in the play.
According to time calculation, Wu Shiyi appeared four years before the plot began. Now Wu Shiyi has been promoted from an ordinary bodyguard to an A-level bodyguard.
At the same time, the system prompt sounded.
"System, sign in."
[Congratulations to the host, you signed in successfully and gained skill combat proficiency. 】
"Combat proficiency?"
Jiang Chen was stunned.
He thought that when he met Wu Shiyi this time, he also signed up for company shares, but he didn't expect that he was proficient in fighting.
At the same time, relevant knowledge about fighting proficiency appeared in Jiang Chen's mind.
"Yes, Mr. Jiang." Wu Shiyi was also very surprised to see Jiang Chen. The task she received before was to protect the boss of Xingchen Investment. However, he did not have any information about Jiang Chen. He thought he was a middle-aged man, but unexpectedly he was a young man.
"This is the contract I asked the legal department to prepare." Jiang Chen picked up the contract on his desk and handed it to Wu Shiyi.
"Three years?"
After reading the contract, Wu Shiyi said: "Mr. Jiang, is this time too long?"
"Is it long?"
Jiang Chen shook his head and said: "If your Shenying Security Company didn't agree, I would have signed a longer contract with you. But don't worry, although the contract is for three years, in addition to the Shenying Security Company, I will also give you some subsidies."
There are a lot of secrets in Jiang Chen. If Wu Shiyi becomes his bodyguard, he will know more or less. In order to ensure that the secret is not leaked, keeping Wu Eleven by your side is undoubtedly the best choice.
"I don't need subsidies." Wu Shiyi said.
"As for the subsidy, your Shenying Security Company has already agreed, so you don't need to worry." Jiang Chen knew what Wu Shiyi was thinking and explained: "In addition, in addition to being my bodyguard and protecting me 24 hours a day, you also have to act as my driver. Is there a problem with this?"
"No." Wu Shiyi shook his head.
"Okay, you go out to find Nie Xingchen and ask her to arrange your work station." Jiang Chen said.
"Okay." Wu Shiyi turned and left.
Jiang Chen leaned on the chair, digesting the knowledge about fighting mastery.
"This fighting proficiency is pretty good. At least with it I can protect myself, but..."
Jiang Chen thought about his physical condition.
Although you already have combat proficiency, if your physical fitness cannot keep up, even if you are proficient in combat, you will not be able to exert your due strength.
"It seems that the next step is to work hard to exercise."
After get off work in the afternoon, Jiang Chen took Wu Shiyi to the mansion of Junyue Mansion.
"Mr. Jiang, do you live alone?" Wu Shiyi asked.
"Yes. But I have already hired a nanny. If there are no accidents, there should be a nanny taking over after a while." Jiang Chen nodded and said, "Wu Shiyi, follow me. I will give you the monitoring authority here, and then record the fingerprints of the electronic lock and elevator."
